source.display_title: 05/04/2026 - Donald Peteranna x Farooq Bey  — Follow Up

prospect.name: Paul Bionaz
prospect.occupation: United States Army, 13 years of service. Recently completed Ranger School and has a Ranger Regiment assessment and selection in approximately three months.
prospect.training_background: Trains almost every day, has unit-assigned strength coaches and nutrition coaches, and access to free gyms. Familiar with kettlebells and their movement techniques. Will be running high endurance volume alongside any strength work in preparation for selection.
prospect.medical: Acute post-Ranger-School depletion, two weeks out at the time of the call. Describes severe caloric deficit and sleep restriction during the course — two meals a day at roughly 4 a.m. and 7 a.m., MREs, 'burning like thousands and thousands of calories while only taking in just 2,000 a day' — with substantial muscle loss and self-described weakness as a result. No injuries, conditions or medications disclosed, and none were asked about. He is under the care of unit strength and nutrition coaches.

signals: Self-directed and highly capable, and said so before anything was presented: 'I'm not necessarily looking for, like, coaching... I'm pretty familiar with kettlebell, at least the movement techniques and whatnot'

Anchored to alternatives that already work and cost nothing — 'I have strength coaches, I have nutrition coaches that are already like assigned to my unit and whatnot. So I kind of have that face to face coaching already' and 'I have access to free gyms'
Wants an artefact rather than a relationship: 'it's just a program, I guess' and 'a program that I can follow for, like, maybe, you know, a month or two'
Conceded the self-sufficiency argument against his own purchase when the rep pressed it: 'nah, you're right. I should be able to'

QUALIFIER ON THE FIT: he is not sceptical of the product, only of needing it, and price was never tested because the one-to-one offer was never formally presented. Confidence is held down accordingly. Same shape as the Hamdi Hmimy call in this batch — capable, already fit, routes himself to the $200 tier.

goals.text: Rebuild the strength and muscle lost during Ranger School
Be physically prepared for Ranger Regiment assessment and selection in about three months
Have a followable structured programme for a fixed block of one to two months rather than open-ended coaching
Train at home rather than at the gym, around two children and an unpredictable schedule

pains.text: Significant muscle loss and weakness from Ranger School — severe caloric deficit and sleep restriction, finished two weeks before the call
Cannot programme for himself — 'it's one thing to plan the program, and it's another thing to execute it. I feel like it's just harder for me to plan it'
No predictable window at home for a 45-minute session, unlike his scheduled morning unit PT

Needs progression across days and weeks, not just single sessions — 'I can just pick up a kettlebell and move it for 30 minutes, but if I don't have something for tomorrow, the next day, and then progressing into next week'

objections.raw_quote: So, I'm not necessarily looking for, like, coaching, but I am looking for, like, a program that I can follow for, like, maybe, you know, a month or two.
objections.rep_response: Probed it once — 'What gives you that confidence and impression to say that for yourself?' — accepted the answer and routed him to the $200/mo self-paced product within ninety seconds

objections.raw_quote: I've been in the army for 13 years. So, you know, I work out like almost every day. And I have, I have strength coaches, I have nutrition coaches that are already like assigned to my unit and whatnot. So, you know, I kind of have that like face to face coaching already, if that makes sense.
objections.rep_response: Agreed with it — 'Makes sense, brother' — and did not attempt to differentiate the offer against free institutional coaching at any point

objections.raw_quote: Yeah. Something I got to think about for sure.
objections.rep_response: 'Okay. No worries, brother. I mean, we're always going to be here.' No play was run at all.

offer.guarantee_mentioned: On Primal University only: 'It's 200 bucks per month, but you can cancel at any point. So some people like yourself may want to come in for a month, test it out, if you like it, you get everything you need... good, you can go on your way.'

evidence: No payment and no decision on anything. Primal University was screen-shared and the link was texted to his phone at his request: 'Will I get the link to that program that you guys have?' — 'Where would you like me to put it?' — 'Text.'
He left it open twice: 'Yeah, I think along those lines, I'd have to consider it' and 'Something I got to think about for sure.'
The rep left the door open rather than closing it out: 'we're always going to be here' and 'Any questions, reach out to me through email or send me a text and I'll happily respond.'

COUNTER-EVIDENCE FOR THE DISPOSITION: no follow-up was booked, no next contact was agreed, and the rep signed off with 'Wish you the best of luck', which reads closer to a close-out than to a live pipeline item.

COUNTER-EVIDENCE: the one-to-one offer was never formally presented — only a vague band, 'roughly from $4,000 to $9,000' — so this is not a rejection of the core product so much as a call where the core product was never put on the table.
NOT scored as lost, because the prospect self-selected out before the rep made any judgement, and the lower-tier product remains genuinely under consideration with a link in his hand.
outcome.next_step: None agreed. Prospect holds a texted Primal University link and may subscribe at $200/mo; contact is on him.

notable.note: Second file in this batch titled for the wrong person — the title names Donald Peteranna and the call is entirely with Paul Bionaz, both on 05/04. On the substance: the shortest call in the batch at twelve minutes, and the only one where none of the three pillars was presented at all. The prospect opened by declining coaching and naming free institutional alternatives — unit strength coaches, unit nutrition coaches, free gyms — and the rep conceded rather than differentiated. The rep then made an unforced error, offering the free-alternative argument himself: 'there's ChatGPT, YouTube, information is so abundant now. Why haven't you been able to piece together your own workout?', to which the prospect answered 'nah, you're right. I should be able to.' The clearest available discovery thread, two children, was mentioned and dropped. Also worth noting for lead-source attribution: the rep referenced a webinar as the reason for the day's volume.

quality.notes: Short call but the labels invert repeatedly on quick turns, including several places where the rep's question and the prospect's answer are merged under one label. Clear examples: 'Where are you calling from, man? I'm in Washington' at 00:00:16 splits across the wrong labels; 'But you already have discipline. You're already working out every day' at 00:09:20 is attributed to Paul Bionaz and is the rep; 'I said, we're always going to be here' at 00:11:05 is attributed to Paul Bionaz and is the rep repeating himself over a bad connection. The call also had audio dropouts and a mid-call switch from phone to laptop. Roles resolved from content.
